Webmozart Assert Source (Local Note)
====================================
Source files for the webmozart/assert package bundled with laminas-mail.

Contents
--------
- Assert.php – assertion helper methods for validating inputs and state.
- InvalidArgumentException.php – exception type thrown when assertions fail.
- Mixin.php – mixin used for IDE/static analysis support.

Notes
-----
- Vendor code; do not edit. Consult the upstream README.md in the parent folder for usage details.
- Altering assertions may change error semantics for dependent packages.
